column1: # kayfabe published constant table (owner rulings §AF/§AH; docs/design/V3_CONSTANT_STRATEGY.md §1-§3; V3_PROVENANCE.md §1).
# STATUS: LIVE, 2026-10-14. Loaded by crates/kf-rm/src/consttab.rs; every rule below is enforced by its tests.
# One row = one value a guest can see that is neither derived (ogkm, kayfabe state) nor answered by the host at runtime.
# A row is a FALLBACK: kayfabe asks the host first (tier 2); the table answers only when the host did not.
#   key       the constant (namespace.cmd for RM controls)
#   die       ogkm die name (kf_chip::die::DIE_NAMES) or * (any die: only with a mechanism tag, never measured:)
#   branch    driver branch (major) the value was measured at, or * (only with a mechanism tag)
#   size      the reply size in bytes (the measured paramsSize; the tail after `words` is MEASURED zero)
#   inputs    request words that must match for the row to apply: off=value,... (byte offsets, hex), or - (no input)
#   words     reply u32 words, hex, little-endian, from offset 0
#   source    measured:<DIE>,<driver>,<YYYY-MM-DD> | ogkm:<tag> <file:line> ... | rule:<mechanism> | authored:<why>. Never blob.
#   evidence  repo path of the evidence (no board data: no UUID, serial, VBIOS, MAC)
# Lookup: exact (die, branch); then (die, *); then (*, branch); then (*, *). A neighbour die's row is never served:
# an unmeasured (die, branch) is refused by name and counted (the clean fallback, §AE).
